description: This Java source file defines utility functions for array manipulations, including arithmetic operations, sorting, copying, normalization, convolution, and various distance metrics. It also introduces interfaces and enums for array operations, ordering, and subarray specifications. The class 'MathArrays' is part of the Apache Commons Math library, providing high-precision arithmetic and array utilities used across mathematical and statistical computations.

classes.name: MathArrays
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for array arithmetic, sorting, copying, normalization, distance calculations, convolution, shuffling, and more, primarily used within the Apache Commons Math library.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Returns a new array where each element is scaled by the provided scalar.

methods.name: scaleInPlace
methods.description: Scales the input array in place by the given scalar.

methods.name: ebeAdd
methods.description: Performs element-by-element addition of two arrays.

methods.name: ebeSubtract
methods.description: Performs element-by-element subtraction of the second array from the first.

methods.name: ebeMultiply
methods.description: Performs element-by-element multiplication of two arrays.

methods.name: ebeDivide
methods.description: Performs element-by-element division of the first array by the second.

methods.name: distance1
methods.description: Calculates the L1 (Manhattan) distance between two points, supporting both double and int arrays.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean (L2) distance between two points, supporting both double and int arrays.

methods.name: distanceInf
methods.description: Calculates the Chebyshev (L-infinity) distance between two points, supporting both double and int arrays.

methods.name: isMonotonic
methods.description: Checks if an array is monotonically increasing or decreasing, for both generic and double types, with strict or non-strict order.

methods.name: checkOrder
methods.description: Validates that an array is ordered according to specified direction and strictness, possibly throwing an exception.

methods.name: checkRectangular
methods.description: Checks if a 2D array (matrix) is rectangular (all rows have the same length).

methods.name: checkPositive
methods.description: Verifies all entries in a double array are strictly positive.

methods.name: checkNotNaN
methods.description: Verifies that no entries in a double array are NaN.

methods.name: checkNonNegative
methods.description: Verifies that all entries in a long array are non-negative.

methods.name: safeNorm
methods.description: Computes a stable Euclidean norm that handles overflow and underflow.

methods.name: sortInPlace
methods.description: Sorts an array in place (ascending or specified order), and permutes other associated arrays accordingly.

methods.name: copyOf
methods.description: Creates a copy of an array, with optional length specification for truncation or padding.

methods.name: copyOfRange
methods.description: Creates a sub-array from a range in the source array.

methods.name: linearCombination
methods.description: Computes a high-precision linear combination of arrays or individual double coefficients, based on Ogita et al.'s algorithms.

methods.name: convolve
methods.description: Computes the convolution of two sequences via straightforward sum.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Validates that provided value and weight arrays, within specified subarray bounds, are non-null, have matching lengths, do not contain NaN or infinite values in weights, have non-negative weights, and include at least one positive weight (unless empty arrays are allowed). Throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: verifyValues
methods.description: Overload of verifyValues that allows zero-length subarrays if allowEmpty is true; performs the same validations.
